name: Theta-class T-2c shuttle
description: The Cygnus Spaceworks Theta-class T-2c shuttle, also known as the Theta-class T-2c Personnel Transport, was a tri-winged personnel transport craft, most often used by influential senators, officers, and courtiers to travel between planets and starships while maintaining high levels of security. Newly appointed Emperor Palpatine used one to save the maimed and burned Darth Vader from the volcanic world of Mustafar.

data.name: Theta-class T-2c shuttle
data.cost: Not available for sale (likely valued at 210,000 to 1,000,000 Republic credits)
